description: This file defines the AdvancedCallableResolverInterface interface within the Slim Framework, extending the CallableResolverInterface. It declares methods for resolving callables for routes and middleware.

classes.name: AdvancedCallableResolverInterface
classes.description: Interface extending CallableResolverInterface, declaring methods for resolving callables for routes and middleware.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a given identifier into a callable for route handling.

methods.name: resolveMiddleware
methods.description: Resolves a given identifier into a callable for middleware.
